No risk at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled.

`bun tools/check-register.ts` exited 0 and read 436 items. It reported 0 at Likelihood 3 or higher that are not closed, accepted, mitigated, transferred or Moved Out. It also reported 0 settled items with no Verified line, 0 Moved Out for a reason other than a part plugins/ does not ship, and 0 items with two Likelihood values.

The checker may only read one Status line per entry, so I parsed `plans/rebuild/risk-register/*.md` myself. 17 entries at Likelihood 3 or higher carry more than one Status line. I did not run the checker's own logic on them. In every one the last Status line is settled. These are the last lines, which are the current status. Earlier lines differ, as the text below notes.

| Entry | Likelihood | Current status | Reason the entry records |
|---|---|---|---|

An earlier status accepted the risk on ADR-0188's allow rule. The entry notes that acceptance was the user's to give. |

RISK-163 (delegation.md) also has three Status lines, but its Likelihood is 1, so it is outside your question. Its entry shows accepted, then open, then closed 2026-11-19.

My parse found only Status lines that start a line, and I did not check the Verified lines. The reasons above are truncated to about 330 characters for the table, so RISK-393, RISK-186, RISK-053 and RISK-103 have more text in the register.
